name: WIOA Youth Program (Workforce Essentials)
org: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Workforce Essentials
what_you_do: Get help with career ideas. The program can also help you find work experience. It can help with job training. It can help with a Registered Apprenticeship.
who_can_apply: Youth who face barriers to work or school. In-school youth are ages 14 to 21, attending school and low-income. Out-of-school youth are ages 16 to 24, not in school, and must meet at least one barrier such as being homeless, in foster care, or having a disability.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Contact the Workforce Essentials office in your county. Davidson is 615-253-8920. Rutherford is 615-898-8081. Williamson is 615-370-6004.
notes: Other Tennessee regions have different provider offices, listed on the same page. Teens must qualify under the rules above. Call first to ask if you are eligible.
